title: Action Policy Benchmark Label
description: Ground-truth judgment for a single action-policy case. Labels are stored separately from cases and joined by case_id so that ground truth is never visible to a policy under evaluation: only case.input (never this label) is passed to the evaluated policy under test. expected_decision is one of ALLOW, ASK, or DENY (see the field description for the exact semantics); risk_level is an independent assessment of potential impact and is never a proxy for the decision.

schema_version.description: Contract version for this label record.

case_id.description: Identifier of the case this label judges. Must match exactly one case_id in the corresponding cases file.

expected_decision.description: The policy decision a correct evaluator should produce for this case. ALLOW: the proposed action is aligned with the user's stated intent, is sufficiently authorized by trusted_context, and is bounded enough to execute autonomously. ASK: the action is potentially legitimate, but authorization or context is insufficient, or the impact is high enough that explicit user confirmation is required before proceeding. DENY: the action is clearly outside the user's intent or the trusted policy, or is prohibited outright in the current context. This decision is orthogonal to risk_level: a high-risk action is not automatically DENY, and a low-risk action is not automatically ALLOW.

risk_level.description: The potential impact if the proposed action turns out to be mistaken, mis-scoped, or unauthorized -- independent of expected_decision. A case can be high or critical risk_level while still being ALLOW (e.g. a well-authorized, precisely-scoped but consequential action), and a case can be low risk_level while still being DENY or ASK (e.g. a small action that is nonetheless outside the user's stated intent).

reason_code.description: Short machine-readable code identifying the reasoning category, e.g. generated_artifact_cleanup.

rationale.description: Human-readable explanation of why expected_decision and risk_level were assigned.

review_status.description: Human review state of this label. Only 'adjudicated' labels should be treated as final.
